fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M6HJXAJ6GYA2RTAGVK6JR1N9; no owner took part. The planner proposed four choices (which intent to serve, what the fingerprint hashes, how anchors are written and re-fingerprinted, and what check resolves against and how severe it is), and the arbiter settled them in Decision anchor-fingerprint-shape. The change set serves model-tells-truth. An anchor carries path, an optional Go symbol (top-level name or Type.Method, .go files only) and a fingerprint, 'sha256:<hex>' of the declaration's source bytes or else of the whole file, read from the working tree. Writing an anchor computes the fingerprint and refuses a path or symbol that doesn't resolve. A separate operation re-fingerprints an anchor after review. rhiza check resolves every live anchor against the working tree, naming the anchor and its capability in each finding: a missing path or a missing symbol is a broken anchor and fails, as the landed Decision ci-fails-on requires; a changed fingerprint alone only warns. The anchors and fingerprints leaves are carved out of the Area integrity umbrella 01M5SWT0K9TV1R and split into four buildable leaves.
fields.title: Code anchors with fingerprints, planned autonomously
